verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of multi-item handling is PRELOAD_MODELS (--preload-models), which takes a JSON list of models to install in one go using the /models/apply parameters. That is a narrow, startup-time bulk install rather than general bulk operations across many items. The other evidence covers single-request APIs, agents and MCP, none of which describe batch actions. Missing for 10: on-demand bulk or batch API operations (e.g., batch inference, bulk delete or update of models, agents or users), bulk actions in the UI or CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: PRELOAD_MODELS (or --preload-models) takes a list in JSON with the same parameter of the API calls of the /models/apply endpoint.
